newsitem.title: UK: Barclays at record in rising sector.
newsitem.headline: Barclays at record in rising sector.

text.p: Shares in Barclays Plc set a record high on Wednesday, continuing recent strength amid a rising bank sector, though dealers said there was no fresh news on the stock.
The stock was up 23-1/2p at 11.33 stg by 0923 GMT after earlier reaching a peak of 11.35 stg -- surpassing its previous high of 11.25 stg set January 15.

"Barclays has just jumped in line with market sentiment," said one dealer. The FTSE 100 reached a record high after gains on Wall Street after comments yesterday from Federal Reserve chief Alan Greenspan provided no fresh shock to the markets.
